## What each step changes

- **Workbook as received.** Reproduces every formula; checked against Excel's saved values.
- **1. Open at year-end 2026.** Opening cash $7.7B (June 30 + July loan + August converts + base-case H2 prepayments and EBITDA − H2 capex); debt $15.0B at principal, of which $0.775B secured; 308.7M shares incl. NVIDIA's pre-funded warrants and the August exchange shares.
- **2. Price at contract rates.** $12M ARR per MW throughout. Same $8B year-end 2026 ARR, so 0.67 GW live at YE26 and 1.08 GW added a year to reach 5 GW; capex kept at $58.7M per MW ($254B program).
- **3. Cash sweep.** All operating cash after interest goes to capex (B67 = 100%) before secured debt, converts or equity.
- **4. Accounting fixes.** Non-GPU capex depreciated over 20 years; $4.0B a year on assets in place at YE26 ($27.4B, same GPU/non-GPU split); opening cash added to equity value for the issue price; EPS on modeled diluted shares instead of a fixed 352.2M.

## Sensitivity: price per MW

Reconciled model (step 4) at a flat ARR per MW. Year-end 2026 ARR stays at $8B, the build still ends at 5 GW, and capex stays at $58.7M per MW, so a lower price means more GW already live at YE26 and less left to build.

| ARR per MW | Basis | 2030 ARR | 2030 EBITDA | 2030 net income, 5-yr GPU life | 2030 net income, 6-yr GPU life | Dilution vs YE26 shares |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $7.4M | Q4 2025 observed ($1.25B ARR / ~170 MW) | $37.0B | $16.7B | $-24.2B | $-19.3B | +85% |
| $8.5M | repo base case (guidance-implied) | $42.5B | $19.1B | $-23.0B | $-17.9B | +76% |
| $12.0M | 5-year contracts (Microsoft ~$11.6-12.9M) | $60.0B | $26.7B | $-17.4B | $-12.0B | +57% |
| $16.0M |  | $80.0B | $35.5B | $-9.7B | $-4.0B | +44% |
| $20.0M | workbook opening | $100.0B | $44.2B | $-1.3B | $3.5B | +35% |
| $25.0M | workbook 2028-30 floor | $125.0B | $55.2B | $7.2B | $11.8B | +29% |

**Break-even:** 2030 net income turns positive at about **$20.6M of ARR per MW** with 5-year GPU lives ($17.9M with 6-year lives). At $58.7M of capex per MW, 64% of it GPUs, a 5-year life costs $7.5M per MW a year in GPU depreciation alone, while a 50% margin on $12M of ARR earns $6.0M of EBITDA.

## What today's share price implies

Value per fully diluted share in 2030 = (2030 EBITDA × multiple − debt + cash) ÷ shares, discounted to today at 12% a year over 4.2 years. Reconciled model (step 4). Existing converts are counted as debt at principal; if they convert instead, shares rise and debt falls, which lowers per-share value when the stock is above the conversion price. ClickHouse and other stakes (~$5 a share) are excluded. Compare with **$221.33** (2026-10-09 close).

| ARR per MW | 2030 value at 6x | Today at 6x | 2030 value at 9.5x | Today at 9.5x |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $7.4M | $70 | $44 | $172 | $107 |

**Implied ARR per MW at $221.33:** **$15.1M** at 6x, **$10.9M** at 9.5x.
